Here we report the discovery of a new transient LSST-AP-DO-170257199649521669 coincident with AT 2024lwa, in the Rubin LSST alert stream, identified by the Lasair broker with an LVRA score of 0.92. The source is associated with the host galaxy SDSSJ223247.22-092647.8 at a redshift of z = 0.057. It currently has magnitude i = 21.30 +/- 0.1 and z = 21.5 +/-0.1 on MJD = 61221.3 but was discovered by Rubin on 61217 with i=21.8 / z=22.16 suggesting the transient is rising. Current absolute magnitude is estimated at M_i = -15.74 and M_z = -15.54 similar to event A of 2009ip; spectroscopic follow-up is highly encouraged.
